name: latest_nav
description: Returns the fund's most recent daily NAV record: date, total NAV, entry price, exit price, and NAV unit price, for FT Capital Multi Class Investment Fund, class FTUS/FTUSLCE (ISIN AU60ETL93373).

name: nav_history
description: Returns the fund's full daily NAV history, one entry per date from inception (2026-04-07) to the latest available date: total NAV, entry price, exit price, NAV unit price, and units on issue.

name: mpi_positions
description: Returns the fund's open futures positions (Material Portfolio Information) for the latest trading day: one entry per position, with date, Bloomberg ticker, side, number of contracts, exchange, description, and contract code. Historical positions are not published.

name: benchmark_history
description: Returns the fund's benchmark percent return, one entry per date, alongside which E-mini S&P 500 futures contract was the lead-month benchmark on that date.

name: fund_metadata
description: Returns the fund's static reference data in the openfunds standard: fund name, ISIN, LEI, class code, currency, fee rates, and service-provider names (administrator, custodian, trustee, auditor).

name: performance
description: Returns the fund's full daily performance history, one entry per date: percent NAV return and percent benchmark return, plus summary metadata (latest percent NAV, alpha, and benchmark return, and the high water mark value and date).

name: performance_vs_benchmark
description: Returns the fund's return against its E-mini S&P 500 benchmark for the same 1, 3, and 6 month periods published in the daily NAV report, as at the latest available date: for each period, the start and end date, the fund's percent return, the benchmark's percent return (chained across every futures contract roll in the period, not a naive price ratio), and the excess return. Benchmark and excess return are left out for a class with no benchmark mapped.

name: personnel
description: Returns Future Trading Capital's named personnel: one entry per person, with id, name, role, a short biography, and LinkedIn profile URL. Call personnel_photo with a returned id to retrieve that person's photo.

name: personnel_photo
description: Returns one named person's photo as a PNG image, watermarked at the moment of the call with a short token this deployment's own audit log also records. Call personnel first to find a valid id.

id.description: A personnel id returned by the personnel tool, for example "george-moskos".
